tlv70233_electrical.assumes: The 300 mA rated output current is from the title and the front page rather than this table, which states the current *limit* rather than the rating.
tlv70233_electrical.document: TI TLV702xx 300-mA Low-IQ Low-Dropout Regulator, SLVSAG6B (September 2010, revised February 2011), served by LCSC for C26833
tlv70233_electrical.shows: Electrical characteristics over -40 to +125 C junction: input voltage range 2.0 to 5.5 V, DC output accuracy -2 to +2 %, dropout 375 mV max at 300 mA, output current limit 320 mA min, ground pin current 55 uA max at no load, PSRR 68 dB at 1 kHz, output noise 48 uVrms. Every figure this board holds the analog rail to is on this page.
